meanings.note: responsibility for a mistake or offense

Forgive me, I will make up for my fault.

meanings.note: short forms виноват / виновата / виноваты are used for 'it's my/your fault'

examples.text: Я ни в чём не виноват.
examples.trans: I'm not to blame for anything.

examples.text: Что за глупости? Значит, Осипенко сам эти деньги украл!
examples.trans: What nonsense? That means Osipenko stole that money himself!

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence
Core Russian part meaning 'even' in everyday speech.

догадываться.gloss: to guess, to suspect, to surmise

examples.trans: I can guess why we are here.

examples.text: Мне кажется, я догадываюсь, почему мы здесь.
examples.trans: I think I can guess why we are here.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.text: Жадность, Паша, должна быть умеренная. Комнатной температуры.
examples.trans: Greed, Pasha, should be moderate. Room temperature.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

жалко.gloss: feel sorry for; it's a pity

meanings.note: impersonal predicate (+ dative of experiencer, + accusative/genitive)

examples.trans: I just feel sorry for him.

examples.text: Что за глупость? Эдик, мне его просто жалко.
examples.trans: What nonsense is that? Edik, I just feel sorry for him.

meanings.en: to fix, to correct, to put right
meanings.note: Prefix 'ис-' ('out from within') marks extraction or exhaustion (stem 'править'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fix, to correct', paired with 'исправлять'.

examples.trans: Excuse us, we will fix everything.

examples.text: Ученик быстро исправил ошибку в тетради.
examples.trans: The pupil quickly corrected the mistake in his notebook.

examples.text: Да, вы знаете, это очень серьёзная операция. Мы всё исправим. До свидания!
examples.trans: Yes, you know, it is a very serious operation. We'll fix everything. Goodbye!
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

examples.trans: I think I've seen you somewhere.

examples.text: Да, там летнее кафе ещё работает.

examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?

examples.text: Молодой человек, а как на тест-драйв записаться?
examples.trans: Young man, how do I sign up for a test drive?

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

обижаться.gloss: to take offence, to be hurt

meanings.en: to take offence, to get upset
meanings.note: Prefix 'об-' ('around, about') marks encirclement or comprehensive action (stem 'ижаться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to take offence, to be hurt', paired with 'обидеться'.

examples.trans: Don't be offended by my words.

examples.text: Да не обижайся ты, Ваня. Сейчас найду подходящую одежду.
examples.trans: Don't take offence, Vanya. I'll find suitable clothes right now.

meanings.note: accusative/genitive его (него after prepositions), dative ему (нему)

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

очаровать.gloss: to charm, to enchant, to captivate

examples.text: Нет, всё правильно. Он тебя очаровал.
examples.trans: No, it all makes sense. He charmed you.

meanings.note: перестань(те)! = stop it!, oh come on!

examples.text: Да перестаньте! Я двадцать лет в карты не играла.
examples.trans: Oh, stop it! I haven't played cards for twenty years.

examples.text: Иначе я перестану давать тебе деньги!
examples.trans: Otherwise I'll stop giving you money!

поехать.gloss: to go (by vehicle), to set off

meanings.en: to go, to set off (by car, bus, train)

examples.trans: All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

examples.text: Это правильно. Я приглашаю вас в общественный совет.
examples.trans: That's right. I'm inviting you onto the public council.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!
